name: Knowledge scan
description: Three times a week (Sunday, Tuesday and Thursday at 06:00 Dubai) the Knowledge Researcher scans the web for every knowledge category and topic the CBO chose on Knowledge Watch, one category per step, each in its own turn, and files dated, sourced items. Up to 12 categories are scanned per run; a step with no category left says so at once. Nothing is sent: the items wait for the weekly digest. Needs a web search provider.

steps.name: Scan category 1
steps.description: The Knowledge Researcher scans the next category this run has not scanned yet.
steps.instruction: Whatever the step before replied, follow the knowledge-scan Skill for ONE category: call `knowledge_watch_scan_brief` with `next` true. If it lists no category, reply NOTHING DUE and stop. Otherwise scan that one category with `web_search` and `read_page`, using each topic's own search terms, and file it with `knowledge_watch_save_items`, with an empty list when nothing new was found. If you cannot search, call `knowledge_watch_report_problem` first. Write nothing any other way. Reply with one line: the category and what was filed.
